data.text: Now I'll write the test file first (TDD, starting red).

Done. Task 2 is implemented and verified. Summary of what I did: - **Contracts** (`packages/ui/src/contracts.ts`): re-exported `WebReview`, `WebDeltaCapability`, `WebDeltaRequirement` (from `web-data.ts`) and `ApprovalFlag` (from `digest.ts`) as types only. - **New review components** under `packages/ui/src/change/`: - `ReviewPanel.tsx` — the six proposal sections with `None` for empties, then deltas. - `DeltaReview.tsx` — `Deltas` section, per-capability `h4`, `Living`/`Proposed` `delta-pair`, with `New requirement`, `Removed`, `Renamed from `, and `No living requirement matched.` wording. - `DigestPanel.tsx` — `Approval digest` with `digestText` and optional flags. - `ApprovalFlags.tsx` — `label — excerpt` list, nothing when empty. - `review.css` — `.review-text` wrapping and the auto-fit `.delta-pair` grid. - **Actions** (`ChangeActions.tsx`, `ChangeActionsPanel.tsx`): optional `flags` prop; flags render inside the Approve item, or before the buttons when there is no approve action. - **ChangeView**: review order (brief → review → tasks → digest → actions), with the flags in the digest only when there is no action client; null/missing review renders the original markup byte-for-byte. - **Tests**: new `tests/ui-review.test.tsx` covering every "Approve review view" scenario, the CSS rules, and a real `getWebChange` document. Both the task verify command and the proposal's `pnpm verify` pass. Result written to `openspec/changes/148-approve-view/.run/results/2.md`.
